en: A black‑and‑white, slightly faded aerial or elevated view of a large Baroque-style castle complex with a tall, ornate spire rising from a central tower, surrounded by dense forested hills. Below and around the castle are a few small village houses, a winding road, and a small bridge over a stream. The background shows rolling countryside and fields. There is no visible printed caption or handwritten text on the image side.
